subject: Important Update Regarding Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear [Recipient], We would like to inform you that your job application for the position of Marketing Coordinator has been shortlisted for the next round of interviews. Please be prepared to attend an in-person interview at our office on Monday, 15th November 2021. Kindly confirm your availability by replying to this email. We look forward to meeting you in person. Best regards, [Company Name]
